codex.verification: Use the installed Codex app-server model/list on a dedicated test account; verify the exact model and effort through an OpenMeld Wake. A bundled release catalog is not account entitlement evidence.

claude-code.verification: Verify the exact Claude Code model ID, --effort values, provider and login method. API model metadata does not establish Claude Code support or alias resolution.

cursor.verification: Capture authenticated Cursor ACP session models. Copy exact compound IDs, including their embedded parameters; do not synthesize them from API model names. Independent reasoning is not supported by the current OpenMeld Cursor adapter.

grok-build.verification: Capture authenticated Grok Build ACP models and reasoning options using the selected executable. xAI API model availability alone does not prove Grok Build availability.

opencode.verification: Capture opencode models <provider> --verbose for the curated providers. Copy exact variant keys, not API reasoning values. Confirm account access and the exact executable version.
